items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: That's where I met Red Callender and Louis Gonzales, a guitar player, and a trumpet player from St. Louis who used to be with Basie, Paul Campbell, and Lester and Bumps, Lee, and me -- we were the band.

ctx.x: Campbell, from Chicago; or from St. Louis. And we had a cooking contest. And Bumps was gonna out-cook Lester. And you never tasted such horrible food. They were gonna what, fry steaks or something, and put gravy on them... God, it was just awful.

That was the only time I was ever in Lester's room. I went in Lester's room with him, and he had a red setter, and the red setter was so hungry that he was eatin' his own shit. Lester was too goddamn stoned all the time to feed him! The damn dog was almost dead. And he was a great, big, beautiful red setter. I forget what he called him.
